key_highlights: Australian equities suffer severe broad-based sell-off, shedding $169 billion over the week amid mounting domestic recession fears.
Macroeconomic indicators deteriorate as unemployment reaches a five-year peak following cumulative RBA cash rate increases.
Property market correction accelerates with Sydney home prices plunging sharply and household borrowing capacity severely curtailed.
Retail landscape bifurcates: David Jones slashes 1,700 roles amid restructuring while Myer actively captures market share.
Junior resource sector sees tactical resilience in gold restarts and high-grade rare earths processing breakthroughs.

sectors.trend: Small-cap gold developers and critical minerals exploration see strong capital market interest and metallurgical breakthroughs despite broader market retreat.
sectors.implications: Provides selective tactical upside for junior gold and rare earth producers benefiting from high AUD-denominated commodity prices and strategic funding.

sectors.trend: Rising credit risk, compounding impacts of five rate hikes on borrower servicing capacity, and corporate governance scrutiny.
sectors.implications: Net interest margin expansion has peaked; credit impairment risks and slowing mortgage growth threaten major bank earnings and valuation premiums.

sectors.trend: Severe downturn in residential property values and worsening affordability metrics across major metropolitan markets.
sectors.implications: Subdued transaction volumes, balance sheet devaluations, and pressured development margins for residential and diversified REITs.

sectors.trend: Department store distress alongside structural demand shifts in food consumption induced by GLP-1 weight-loss medications and ACCC expansion scrutiny.
sectors.implications: Discretionary retail faces margin compression and volume contraction; major grocers face regulatory headwinds and shifting basket composition.

sectors.trend: Elevated geopolitical conflict in the Middle East threatening Strait of Hormuz transit, contrasted with domestic infrastructure delays.
sectors.implications: Supports oil price risk premiums, benefiting domestic LNG and crude producers as global supply risk escalates.

sectors.trend: Rapid enterprise AI adoption causing white-collar employment disruption while private AI equity valuations generate high liquidity.
sectors.implications: ASX software and IT services firms face dual pressures of rapid technological displacement and heightened capital allocation competition.

key_themes: RBA overtightening and compounding monetary lag risking hard economic landing
Rapid housing market deflation and erosion of household balance sheets
Divergence between defensive resource niches (gold/rare earths) and consumer-facing cyclicals
Escalating Middle East geopolitical friction underpinning energy security premiums
Structural disruption from AI adoption across labor markets and corporate operations

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight cyclical and discretionary equities; tilt toward sovereign bonds, cash, and non-cyclical defensive earners.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing Market Deflation & Bank Credit Stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to domestic mortgage-dependent lenders; focus on high-quality industrial REITs with long WALE.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Middle East Geopolitical Escalation & Supply Disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hold long exposure to energy producers and physical gold proxies to hedge against shipping and commodity price shocks.
Overweight ASX-listed offshore earners with US dollar revenues and local cost bases.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Unhedged Gold Producers and Advanced Developers
opportunities.rationale: Beneficiaries of safe-haven demand amid Middle East conflict and margin expansion driven by AUD weakness against USD.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical Long in Department Store Consolidators
opportunities.rationale: Myer positioned to capture market share, suppliers, and foot traffic from the downsizing and distress at David Jones.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective Exposure to Upstream Critical Minerals
opportunities.rationale: High-recovery technological breakthroughs and US strategic partnerships offer isolated growth vectors detached from macro headwinds.

defensive_moves.rationale: Confluence of five-year high unemployment, rapid housing deflation, and governance issues pressures credit quality and return on equity.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Implement Downside Protection on Benchmark Equities
defensive_moves.rationale: Broad market sell-off and macroeconomic recession risk warrant cash preservation or inverse ETF hedging on the ASX 200.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce Exposure to Supermarket Staples Facing Growth Caps and Volume Shift
defensive_moves.rationale: ACCC regulatory blocks to store expansion and long-term consumption headwinds from GLP-1 weight-loss drugs dampen volume growth.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish bias for the S&P/ASX 200 (^AXJO) over the next 1–3 months as severe housing deflation, five-year high unemployment, and rate hike lagged impacts weigh on corporate earnings.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously neutral over 6–12 months; market stabilization contingent on RBA monetary easing cycle commencement and resilient commodity exports to counter domestic contraction.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate announcements and monetary policy forward guidance
Australian Bureau of Statistics labor force and quarterly CPI data releases
CoreLogic national home value indices and bank mortgage arrears reports
Geopolitical escalation in the Strait of Hormuz impacting global crude benchmarks
ACCC regulatory rulings and supermarket pricing inquiries
watch_list: AUD/USD exchange rate stability around key support levels
S&P/ASX 200 (^AXJO) support levels following the $169B correction
Crude oil (Brent) and physical gold spot prices
Bank bad debt provisioning and mortgage stress indicators
Consumer discretionary retail sales and foot traffic trends
